Body.raw:
Build the on-device interaction platform for Waveshare ESP32-S3-Knob-Touch-LCD-1.8 while HILEVEL.md is still unlocked.

Scope: WiFi STA, LVGL (or agreed) UI shell, rotary encoder input, CST816 touch, basic screens (follow chrome stub, zone list stub). No Sonos/Volumio protocol depth here -- emit/consume abstract UI events and show fake/fixture state until audio library ports in.

Ratchet: each WorkItem ends with a flashable or host-testable artifact + short note of what locked (pins, LVGL pattern, encoder debounce). Prefer tests where feasible (host mocks; on-device smoke checklist as LOCAP).

Parallel with audio-control Python subtodo; do not block on Flask library.
